title: Count Square Submatrices with All Ones
description: Given a m x n binary matrix, return the number of square submatrices with all ones using dynamic programming.

steps.note: Initialize DP table based on input matrix [[0,1],[1,1]].
Check cell (1, 1). It is 1 and not on the boundary.
Update cell (1, 1) based on neighbors: min(0, 1, 1) + 1 = 1.
Sum all values in matrix: 0+1+1+2 = 4 total squares.
